input_view.description: Public input View projection. Routing, validation rules and secret-storage flags stay at the host; created_at is the engine timestamp.

input_field.description: Public input fields omit engine-derived secrecy flags and executable validators. Constraints reference the same normalized field vocabulary.

input_result.description: Public input close receipt. Submitted values and secret handles are returned only to the waiting extension, never to the event stream.

live_close.description: Public live close receipt. SSE may omit the already-streamed view; consumers retain the picture assembled from open and patch events. Journal polling may include the settled view.
